tests.stimulus: Apply asynchronous active-low reset before using history; use the fixed four-lane/two-bank instance and stable binary inputs around rising edges. Build all state through native inputs and accepted handshakes. Write nonzero data to both banks, leave requests and responses pending, and assert reset between clock edges, including a short pulse entirely between rising edges. Exercise all binary masks after reset.
tests.expected: Both memory and history restart from zero immediately after reset settles; ready is one, valid and every response payload bit are zero.
tests.checker: Sample every native output after rising-edge updates and after reset falling edges, including a reset pulse wholly between clock edges. Use a consistent settled observation after nonblocking assignments; one nanosecond is the reference implementation choice, not a required candidate delay. Do not gate payload comparisons on response valid or lane activity. Use a separately maintained input-history memory/pipeline/replay/queue predictor; it reads no DUT output. Compare all six native outputs with four-state inequality at each specified settled sample and report a normal UVM error on any mismatch. Record nonzero comparison and reset-event counts; no predicted-versus-predicted self-check.
